scenario.task:
My service is suspended, but I can't pay the full balance today. I want to make a payment arrangement to restore it

User Guide: State that your service is suspended. Authenticate. When told you owe money, ask if you can set up a payment arrangement. Agree to the terms and confirm service restoration If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
